support_policy: 8.0.0: existing management APIs remain compatible with 7.0 servers. Release requires the verified same-source Android controller SDK. VP8/Surface and keyboard/pointer/text use direct UDP; physical-device decoding and end-to-end input remain unverified. System audio, microphone return, clipboard/file delivery, multi-session UI and AV1/HEVC are unavailable. FRP retains its upstream version.
